authority: User requests Luna low/medium/high for implementation and Astra high/xhigh for reviews and bug fixing, with Fast preference.
status: reviewed planning policy; no frontend implementation launched

luna-medium.role: default bounded implementation or evidence collection

astra-debug.role: evidence-led behavioral bug diagnosis and repair

astra-deep-debug.role: difficult unresolved bug diagnosis and repair

packet_rules.low_is_packet_only: No whole multi-behavior task is assigned Low; coordinator may extract mechanical subpackets with exact oracle and no new lifecycle/identity policy.
packet_rules.high_parent_can_split: Rendering/mechanical subpackets can use Medium/Low after concrete state contract and ownership are proven; record packet-level override and reason.
packet_rules.same_crate_proof: INT.1 must prove actual private consumer/provider reachability before parallel feature dispatch.
packet_rules.acceptance: All packet outcomes/checks plus real joins remain required to close the parent.

review_rules.batching: Small low/normal-risk packets within one workflow and exact integrated candidate may share an Astra High session. Every packet receives Standards and Spec verdicts; required checks/captures are not sampled.
review_rules.dedicated: Shared-boundary/transaction/renderer/identity changes reviewed separately; existing approved consumer contracts need no repeated design review.
review_rules.preimplementation: Luna High drafts concrete contracts; Astra reviews before dependent implementation, without approving public API changes on behalf of user.
review_rules.repair_independence: If Astra edits a repair, a different reviewer assesses that delta.
review_rules.extra_high: Use only for material uncertainty unresolved at High or a demonstrated difficult race/scope/transaction bug.
review_rules.scope_upgrade: Any discovered new async/gesture/scope/ownership uncertainty upgrades a previously routine packet review.
review_rules.evidence_freshness: Exact commit/diff/build identity; later changes require affected rechecks/review.
review_rules.contract_reuse: The seven flagged parent tasks require a current reviewed contract, not seven additional review sessions. F7.3 may consume the exact approved F7.1 contract and F8.2 the exact approved BND.2 contract. Re-review only new/materially changed boundaries, insufficient proof, or changed consumer placement. Integrated implementation review remains required.

escalation.mechanical_errors: Author may fix obvious compiler/type/format errors normally; recurring failure with no new evidence triggers diagnosis.
escalation.behavioral_regression: Retain failing public reproduction and candidate; Astra High diagnoses/fixes instead of repeated speculative Luna rewrites.
escalation.high_to_xhigh: Escalate unresolved material reasoning/bug with prior hypotheses and evidence.
escalation.approval_boundaries: Existing public API/visibility/schema/cutover approvals are unchanged.

steady_state: one Luna verifier; rotate to Astra reviewer when ready
concurrency.three_builders: Short initial exception only with disjoint owners and no review/verification backlog.
concurrency.shared_files: coordinator serializes; browser sessions/stores isolated; CAD-heavy checks serial

runtime_observation.effective_child_tier: unverified unless runtime metadata reports it

calibration: After first accepted tranche, record first-pass acceptance, defect categories, retry/review time and observed usage; adjust bounded packet size/effort without weakening gates.
